verses.ar: هَلِّلُويَا. سَبِّحُوا يَا عَبِيدَ ٱلرَّبِّ. سَبِّحُوا ٱسْمَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
verses.web: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.

verses.ar: لِيَكُنِ ٱسْمُ ٱلرَّبِّ مُبَارَكًا مِنَ ٱلْآنَ وَإِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

verses.ar: مِنْ مَشْرِقِ ٱلشَّمْسِ إِلَى مَغْرِبِهَا ٱسْمُ ٱلرَّبِّ مُسَبَّحٌ.
verses.kjv: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name [is] to be praised.
verses.web: From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ عَالٍ فَوْقَ كُلِّ ٱلْأُمَمِ. فَوْقَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ مَجْدُهُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] high above all nations, [and] his glory above the heavens.
verses.web: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

verses.ar: مَنْ مِثْلُ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِنَا ٱلسَّاكِنِ فِي ٱلْأَعَالِي؟
verses.kjv: Who [is] like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
verses.web: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,

verses.ar: ٱلنَّاظِرِ ٱلْأَسَافِلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَفِي ٱلْأَرْضِ،
verses.kjv: Who humbleth [himself] to behold [the things that are] in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.web: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

verses.ar: ٱلْمُقِيمِ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ مِنَ ٱلتُّرَابِ، ٱلرَّافِعِ ٱلْبَائِسَ مِنَ ٱلْمَزْبَلَةِ
verses.kjv: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, [and] lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.web: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

verses.ar: لِيُجْلِسَهُ مَعَ أَشْرَافٍ، مَعَ أَشْرَافِ شَعْبِهِ.
verses.kjv: That he may set [him] with princes, [even] with the princes of his people.
verses.web: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُسْكِنِ ٱلْعَاقِرَ فِي بَيْتٍ، أُمَّ أَوْلَادٍ فَرْحَانَةً. هَلِّلُويَا.
verses.kjv: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [and to be] a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.web: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
